Cannabis Strain Review: Chocolope By DNA Genetics

Leafly Cannabis Strain Overview:

DNA Genetics developed Chocolope by crossing Chocolate Thai with Cannalope Haze to create their homage to the Chocolate strains of the 1980s. The hefty sativa buds give earthy, sweet coffee flavors that provide a dreamy, cerebral effect. Consumers report a strong, euphoric mental shift that is great when coping with depression or stress.

TMK Cannabis Strain Review:

Honestly this strain has some amazing qualities. I was able to acquire some from a local New England Dispensary and it is one of those strains that is soft and sticky to the touch. When grown properly, it comes action packed THC crystals and has a nice smooth fully bodied smoke with sweet undertones that really do taste delicious. Overall it packs a good amount of power with just a small amount, making it a great strain if you need to make your cannabis last. The overall medicinal effect definitely has good stress and anxiety relief properties that help you relax from a hard day at work. The only negative side effects are that I do tend to get the munchies on this strain, so have snacks at the ready. Chocolope by DNA Genetics gets a solid 8 out of 10 on my scale of cannabis awesomeness.

If you have had a chance to try this strain, please feel free to leave a comment below. Its great to hear how medicine can effect different people and I would love to know if you had similar experiences with this cannabis strain.
